subject: Private fleet: upgrade decision log, pinning choices & rollback options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, Jonathan Price <jonathan.price@acmehealth.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private fleet: upgrade decision log, pinning choices & rollback options

Team + Jonathan —

We're at the point where Acme's private deployment needs a controlled upgrade from 2.0.9 -> 2.1.4 (runtime + orchestration stack). Before we lock a maintenance window I want a short decision log capturing pinning strategy, maintenance window proposal, and the concrete rollback primitives so Acme can sign off from security/compliance.

Key proposal (high level):
- Target version: 2.1.4 (security backports + kernel selection fix)
- Pin policy: staged pin on 10% of nodes (canary), then 50%, then full. Pinning realized via version labels (fleet metadata) and per-tenant routing rules.
- Maintenance window (proposal): Tue Apr 6, 23:00 - Wed Apr 7, 02:00 PT (3hr) — low traffic for Acme's region.
- Rollback primitives: retain last-good image (2.0.9) in local registry; automated rollback playbook that (1) drains traffic, (2) redeploys pinned 2.0.9 with original KV cache snapshot, (3) verifies health probes, (4) re-adds to LB.

Open questions for internal ops:
1) Is the cross-region route swap and BGP advertising change covered in the current runbook? (laura)
2) Do we need an extra read-only window for the metadata DB before the first canary? (dev/monica)
3) Telemetry: which traces/metrics are mandatory to validate success (grace)?

Attachments: upgrade-decision-draft.xlsx (live decision matrix), network-topo-v2.pdf (current customer topology).

Please reply with short bullets — I want this finalized by EOD so Acme can route to their auditors.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Field Eng, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private fleet: upgrade decision log, pinning choices & rollback options

Sergio — quick notes from infra standpoint:

- BGP/route swap: current runbook only covers a plain route-replace, not a live BGP withdraw/announce sequence. We should add explicit BGP withdraw step and a 2-minute hold before re-advertise to avoid flap. I'll add exact commands to the runbook.
- Canary sizing: instead of 10% node-based, prefer traffic-weighted canary by route tables (simpler for Acme's cross-AZ setup). We'll still pick nodes in the same AZ for cache locality.
- Metadata DB: recommend a 30-minute read-only pre-canary window. This catches schema drift in the admin service that caused issues in the last minor. dev, Monica — can you confirm migration safety?
- Health probes: require 5 consecutive green checks (1s interval) and a synthetic inference test (prompt: "health-check-synthetic: [ping test]") that validates KV cache warmup.

I'll update the 'network-topo-v2.pdf' notes into the draft.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Ops Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Sergio/Laura — thanks for the plan. Acme security has two asks before we approve:

1) Downtime SLA: what is the worst-case customer impact (RTO estimate) if we hit a rollback? We need a clear number to present to our SREs and procurement.
2) Audit artifacts: can you provide the audit log slice (last 90 days of admin events) and the SOC2 evidence referenced in your compliance pack? Our audit team will expect a bundle.

Maintenance window: Tue Apr 6, 23:00 - 02:00 PT is acceptable for us — please confirm rollback RTO and that you will keep a read-only snapshot of the metadata DB.

Action: If you can produce the final decision log (with runbook link) and the audit bundle by EOD Monday Apr 5 we can route for approval.

Thanks,

johnathan.price@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Private fleet: upgrade decision log, pinning choices & rollback options

Jonathan / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Finalizing decisions below (this is the decision log we will attach to the customer approval package):

Finalized items:
- Version: 2.1.4 (security/compat fixes) — last-known-good image: 2.0.9 retained in registry as "acme/agent:2.0.9-lastgood".
- Pinning policy: traffic-weighted canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% (by route table ID). We will keep node-selection AZ-affine for cache locality.
- Read-only DB snapshot: a consistent snapshot will be taken T-45 minutes before first canary. Migration safety confirmed: dev (Dev Patel) and Monica ran the migration checklist locally and saw no schema changes that would break 2.0.9 reads.
- Telemetry gates (grace): require (a) 5 consecutive health probes, (b) synthetic inference test pass, (c) tail latency p95 under 350ms for 10 minutes post-canary.
- BGP/route plan (laura): we'll run withdraw + 2-minute hold + re-announce on cutover to avoid flap. Commands and checklist added to runbook.
- RTO Guarantee: worst-case rollback RTO is 25 minutes from decision to traffic restoration (drain + redeploy + health verification). This includes KV cache restore window assumptions.

Action items (owners & timeline):
- Laura: add BGP command sequence + runbook snippet — due Mon Apr 5 11:00 PT.
- Dev & Monica: produce DB snapshot test note and store snapshot on customer-facing storage — due Mon Apr 5 14:00 PT.
- Grace: create the telemetry gate dashboard and an alert channel for the customer SREs — due Mon Apr 5 15:00 PT.
- Sergio: assemble final-decision-log-20270402.md and upload to Drive + attach audit bundle — due Mon Apr 5 17:00 PT.

Attachments included in the approval packet: final-decision-log-20270402.md (attached), drive link (shared above), audit-bundle-90d.zip (will be added to the Drive folder).

Jonathan — once the Monday artifacts are uploaded, can Acme's audit team confirm a 24-hour review window so we can run on Tue night? If not, we will hold to the next available window.

Thanks all — will follow up with a short runbook rehearsal on Mon 16:00 PT if that works for everyone.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Field Eng, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
